about: Built by tools/build_hmnh.py. Traced from the floor plan in the Harvard Museums of Science & Culture wayfinding brochure (July 2023): every gallery on the third floor, admissions and the shop, the stairs from the Oxford Street entrance, the elevator from the ground-level accessible entrance, restrooms and the water fountain. The brochure’s plan is a diagram, so walls and doors are approximate.
source: Harvard Museums of Science & Culture, wayfinding brochure (July 2023)
